senses.definition: Belonging to the sex which typically produces eggs (ova), or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
senses.example: female authors, the leading male and female artists, a female bird cooing at a male

senses.definition: Characteristic of this sex/gender. (Compare feminine, womanly.)
senses.example: stereotypically female pastimes, an insect with typically female coloration

senses.definition: Tending to lead to or regulate the development of sexual characteristics typical of this sex.
Feminine; of the feminine grammatical gender.
senses.example: The teacher's voice inflects the pulse of nêhiyawêwin as he teaches us. He says a prayer in the first class. Nouns, we learn, have a gender. In French, nouns are male or female, but in Cree, nouns are living or non-living, animate or inanimate.

senses.definition: Lacking the F factor, and able to receive DNA from another bacterium which does have this factor (a male).
senses.example: In this process, one bacterium designated the male bacterium transfers its DNA into the female bacterium. Bacteria are determined to be male or female by a small piece of DNA, called F-plasmid, or sex factor. Bacteria with this small piece of DNA are labeled as males, and bacteria that do not have this factor are considered females.

senses.definition: Having an internal socket, as in a connector or pipe fitting.
senses.example: A ground-joint union is made in three separate pieces and is used for joining two pipes. It consists of two machined pieces with female pipe threads, which are screwed on the pipes to be united, and a threaded collar which holds the two pieces of the union together.

senses.definition: One of the female (feminine) sex or gender.
senses.example: Accumulated data indicate that in all species of sharks, the females grow larger than the males.

senses.definition: A bacterium which lacks the F factor, and is able to receive DNA from another bacterium which has that factor.
senses.example: During mating, F+ male bacteria transfer the F factor to the recipient females, transforming them into F+ males.

senses.definition: A female connector, pipe fitting, etc.
senses.example: These are the most common type, as they join females of the same diameter together. […] For example, you may need an adapter such as a 3-in. pipe thread (a common thread used to join pipes) female to 2 1⁄2 NH male.
